approach: Native Xbox 360 source port of reconstructed Melee code, with PowerPC, Xenos/Direct3D 9 and XInput integration.
notes: Experimental public XEX builds tested in Xenia Canary. Original menus, VS combat and partial Classic/Adventure are implemented; fidelity, collisions, campaign completeness and physical Xbox 360 validation remain pending. Requires the user's own game data.
